item.description:

COMPASS and SONYC is one of DYCD's largest programs, with over 820 programs collectively throughout the five boroughs. Families rely on these programs to provide elementary and middle school students, during after school hours, summer and on holidays, programing which includes educational support, recreation, enrichment, and cultural activities to support and strengthen the overall development of our youth. item.title: NOTICE OF RATIFICATION OF A MINOR RULES VIOLATION
item.description:
Probation | Special Materials | Notice | Flagged: Special Materials (non-routine)

NOTICE OF RATIFICATION OF A MINOR RULES VIOLATION

On August 27, 2026, pursuant to Section 1-02(h)(1)(ii) of the New York City Procurement Policy Board Rules (PPB Rules), the City Chief Procurement Officer (CCPO) ratified a Minor Rules Violation request submitted by the New York City Department of Probation (DOP) in connection with the M/WBE Small Purchase procurement for Agency Shredding Services.

The Minor Rules Violation concerned compliance with PPB Rule §2-11 relating to the timing of the public notice and comment process. The City Record notice was published on March 24, 2026, with comments due March 27, 2026, which did not provide the required seven-day public comment period. The agreement was also executed by the parties before completion of a compliant public notice and comment process.

DOP and the CCPO determined that the procedural violations had no significant adverse impact on the procurement process and that ratification is in the best interests of the City.

Vendor: Cleanwork Solutions LLC

item.title: Clarke Bronx Family Criminal Courthouse Roof Upgrade
item.description:
Design and Construction | Procurement | Award | $18.9M | Vendor: Corbex Inc. | Flagged: Contract value ≥ $1M

This project consists of full replacement of the existing roofing systems at all roof levels to provide a system with an associated long-term warranty and complying with current energy efficiency standards. A total of 45,300SF roof area, in 26 separate roofs at nine different floor levels will receive a new roofing system of two types: cold-applied liquid roofing and paver-protected cold-applied liquid roofing. The concrete deck cracks, delamination, and any other form of deterioration will be repaired from the exterior and interior sides. A new roof rail guard will be installed, and all existing roof guard rails will be reinforced. All existing roof drains will be retrofitted with new retrofit roof drains. The limited mechanical work scope includes replacing two existing RTUs with two new similar units. Electrical scope includes reconnection of the two new RT units and replacement of exterior light fixtures at the Cooling Tower Courtyard. CB: Bronx 4

Transportation | Public Hearings and Meetings | Public Hearings | Hearing: 2026-10-07 | Flagged: Environmental / health hearing

Bronx County (Bronx) - The Federal Highway Administration (FHWA), the New York State Department of Transportation (NYSDOT), as joint lead agencies, and the New York City Department of Transportation (NYC DOT), as project sponsor and joint lead agency, have made available the Draft Design Report (DDR) / NEPA Draft Environmental Impact Statement (DEIS) for the Shore Road Bridge over the Hutchinson River Project. In compliance with SEQRA/CEQR, the NYC DOT has also prepared additional documentation to cover topics not addressed in the DDR/NEPA DEIS.

The purpose of the Project is to address the structural deficiencies; geometric deficiencies; and operational reliability for multi-modal users, including marine vessels, of the Shore Road Bridge over the Hutchinson River. The existing Shore Road Bridge is over 115 years old and is an 865-foot-long bridge with seven spans. The main span over the navigation channel is a double-leaf movable bascule span, which opens for the passage of marine vessels. The bridge is located within Pelham Bay Park between the Bronx and Pelham Parkway and City Island Road along Shore Road in the Borough of Bronx, New York.
